Kennedy Rules Discord™ AkaStve Sl453128 Numnum22 Recent Blogs Recent Changes Affiliates Emeraldblade95 Jester of Chaos Dual89 Proxima Kyurem147 Mesektet NerdWithAKeyboard ShockwaveDude120 Zombiehood68 Jaxnys JayAnimeLover201011 Pure Good Criteria Pure Good Proposals Proposal Permissions Discussion Dates Jaskirat Singh Rangi Jaskirat Singh Rangi, better known in Pakistan as Hamza Ali Mazari, is a (fictitious) former convict turned RAW agent operating in Lyari as a part of Rehman Dakait's criminal gang. He originates from the Indian spy-thriller film Dhurandhar and it's sequel, Dhurandhar Part 2: The Revenge, portrayed by Ranveer Singh. Originally born in India in the city of Pathankot located in the Indian state of Punjab, not much has been revealed about Jaskirat's past aside from him having committed murders that resulted in him being a death row inmate. He would be picked by Ajay Sanyal to be part of operation Dhurandhar; a long term infiltration of the Pakistan underworld to systematically gain control of the criminal network and prevent any further terror attacks. He would join Rehman Dakait's gang before killing Rehman shortly after Rehman's role as a terrorist was revealed. Community content is available under CC-BY-SA unless otherwise noted.
